description: LSM-Style + Observational Memory Compaction System - Hybrid deterministic artifact compaction with LLM-written narrative memory for ADK

userStories.title: Define artifact compaction data models
userStories.description: As a developer, I need Pydantic models for ToolRunCompaction, PatchCompaction, and shared sub-models (CompactionStats, FileLineRef, HunkSummary, Provenance) so that deterministic compaction artifacts have a well-defined schema.
acceptanceCriteria: Create new module at src/google/adk/compaction/ with __init__.py

Create src/google/adk/compaction/models.py with shared sub-models: CompactionStats (raw_tokens_est, compact_tokens_est, compression_ratio), FileLineRef (path, line, col optional), HunkSummary (path, anchor_before, anchor_after, snippet), Provenance (event_id, stdout_offsets optional, stderr_offsets optional)

ToolRunCompaction model with fields: event_id (str), compaction_version (int), command (str), exit_code (int), duration_ms (int optional), error_signatures (list[str]), key_errors (list[str]), tests_failed (list[str]), file_line_refs (list[FileLineRef]), trimmed_trace (list[str]), salient_snippets (list[str]), stats (CompactionStats), provenance (Provenance)

PatchCompaction model with fields: event_id (str), compaction_version (int), files_changed (list[str]), hunks (list[HunkSummary]), semantic_tags (list[str]), stats (CompactionStats), provenance (Provenance)
All models use Pydantic v2 with ConfigDict(extra='forbid'), alias_generator=alias_generators.to_camel, populate_by_name=True
All models are serializable to/from JSON (round-trip test)
Typecheck/lint passes

userStories.title: Define observational memory data models
userStories.description: As a developer, I need Pydantic models for Observation, Reflection, and TaskStateAnchor so that the LLM-written narrative memory layer has a well-defined schema.
acceptanceCriteria: Add to src/google/adk/compaction/models.py: EvidenceRef model with fields: ref_type (str, e.g. 'event', 'tool_run', 'patch', 'observation'), ref_id (str)
Add Decision model with fields: text (str), kind (Literal['explicit', 'inferred']), evidence_refs (list[EvidenceRef])
Add EvidencedItem model with fields: text (str), evidence_refs (list[EvidenceRef])

Observation model with fields: observation_id (str, default uuid), session_id (str), start_seq (int), end_seq (int), text (str), decisions (list[Decision]), learned_constraints (list[Decision]), open_questions (list[EvidencedItem]), next_steps (list[EvidencedItem]), evidence_refs (list[EvidenceRef])

Reflection model with fields: reflection_id (str, default uuid), session_id (str), covers_observation_ids (list[str]), text (str), stable_facts (list[EvidencedItem]), recurring_failures (list[EvidencedItem]), strategy_updates (list[EvidencedItem]), evidence_refs (list[EvidenceRef])

TaskStateAnchor model with fields: session_id (str), state_version (int, default 0), objective (str), constraints (list[EvidencedItem]), hypotheses (list[EvidencedItem]), known_failures (list[EvidencedItem]), current_plan (list[EvidencedItem]), next_steps (list[EvidencedItem]), last_updated_seq (int)
All models use same Pydantic v2 ConfigDict conventions as US-001
All models are serializable to/from JSON (round-trip test)
Typecheck/lint passes

userStories.title: Implement base compactor and generic fallback compactor
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the BaseToolRunCompactor abstract class, GenericToolRunCompactor fallback, and ToolRunCompactorRegistry so that compactors have a consistent interface and unknown tools get basic extraction.
acceptanceCriteria: Create src/google/adk/compaction/compactors/__init__.py
Create src/google/adk/compaction/compactors/base.py with BaseToolRunCompactor abstract class having method compact(event: Event) -> ToolRunCompaction | None

Create src/google/adk/compaction/compactors/generic.py with GenericToolRunCompactor that extracts: exit code, last N lines of stderr (configurable, default 20), any file:line patterns found via regex, and computes CompactionStats

Create src/google/adk/compaction/compactors/registry.py with ToolRunCompactorRegistry that selects the right compactor based on command string matching (register method + get_compactor method), falls back to GenericToolRunCompactor
GenericToolRunCompactor caps output to configurable token budget (default 600 tokens)
Unit tests for GenericToolRunCompactor with sample tool output showing file:line extraction and stderr trimming
Unit tests for ToolRunCompactorRegistry command matching and fallback
Typecheck/lint passes

userStories.title: Implement PytestCompactor
userStories.description: As a coding agent framework, I want to extract structured artifacts from pytest output so that exact test failures, assertion messages, and file:line refs survive compaction.
acceptanceCriteria: Create src/google/adk/compaction/compactors/pytest_compactor.py with PytestCompactor extending BaseToolRunCompactor
Extracts test names from FAILED/ERROR lines (e.g. 'FAILED tests/test_auth.py::test_login')
Extracts assertion messages (lines starting with 'E   ')
Extracts file:line refs from traceback lines
Computes normalized error signatures (format: 'pytest::ErrorType::test_path::test_name')
Populates tests_failed, error_signatures, key_errors, file_line_refs, trimmed_trace, salient_snippets fields
Caps output to configurable token budget (default 600 tokens)
Computes CompactionStats with raw vs compact token estimates
Register PytestCompactor in the registry for commands matching 'pytest'
Unit tests with real pytest output samples (at least 2: short failure, multi-failure with traceback) achieving >10x compression while preserving all error signatures and file:line refs
Typecheck/lint passes

userStories.title: Implement MypyCompactor and RuffCompactor
userStories.description: As a coding agent framework, I want to extract structured artifacts from mypy and ruff/flake8 output so that error codes, file:line refs, and messages survive compaction.
acceptanceCriteria: Create src/google/adk/compaction/compactors/mypy_compactor.py with MypyCompactor extending BaseToolRunCompactor
MypyCompactor extracts: error codes (e.g. [assignment]), file:line:col refs, error messages from mypy output format 'path:line:col: error: message [code]'
MypyCompactor computes normalized error signatures (format: 'mypy::code::path')
Create src/google/adk/compaction/compactors/ruff_compactor.py with RuffCompactor extending BaseToolRunCompactor
RuffCompactor extracts: rule codes (e.g. E501, F401), file:line:col refs, error messages from ruff output format 'path:line:col: code message'
RuffCompactor computes normalized error signatures (format: 'ruff::code::path')
Both compactors cap output to configurable token budget (default 400 tokens)
Register both in the registry for commands matching 'mypy' and 'ruff'/'flake8'
Unit tests with real mypy output sample (at least 3 errors) and ruff output sample (at least 3 violations)
Typecheck/lint passes

userStories.title: Implement PatchCompactor for unified diffs
userStories.description: As a coding agent framework, I want to compress unified diffs into structured summaries preserving changed files and key hunks.
acceptanceCriteria: Create src/google/adk/compaction/compactors/patch_compactor.py with PatchCompactor class having method compact(event: Event) -> PatchCompaction | None
Parses unified diff format (--- a/path, +++ b/path, @@ lines)
Extracts list of changed files and hunk count per file
Extracts key hunks with before/after anchor lines and trimmed snippet
Prioritizes hunks by size (larger changes first) when budget exceeded
Caps output to configurable token budget (default 800 tokens)
Computes CompactionStats with raw vs compact token estimates
Unit tests with sample unified diffs (single file, multi-file, large diff exceeding budget) showing correct extraction
Typecheck/lint passes

userStories.title: Implement pluggable compaction storage interface and InMemory implementation
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a storage abstraction for compaction artifacts following ADK's abstract base + implementation pattern.
acceptanceCriteria: Create src/google/adk/compaction/storage/__init__.py
Create src/google/adk/compaction/storage/base_compaction_service.py with BaseCompactionService abstract class

Abstract methods: save_tool_run_compaction(), save_patch_compaction(), save_observation(), save_reflection(), save_task_state(), get_tool_run_compaction(event_id), get_patch_compaction(event_id), get_observations(session_id, seq_range optional), get_latest_reflection(session_id), get_task_state(session_id), query_by_error_signature(signature), query_by_file_path(path)
All methods are async, consistent with ADK's async patterns
Create src/google/adk/compaction/storage/in_memory_compaction_service.py with InMemoryCompactionService using dicts

Unit tests for InMemoryCompactionService covering: save and retrieve each artifact type, query_by_error_signature returns matching compactions, query_by_file_path returns matching compactions, get_observations with seq_range filtering
Typecheck/lint passes

userStories.title: Integrate deterministic compaction into runner pipeline
userStories.description: As a developer, I want deterministic compactions to run automatically after each tool call event so compacted artifacts are available without manual intervention.
acceptanceCriteria: Create src/google/adk/compaction/config.py with HybridEventsCompactionConfig extending or paralleling EventsCompactionConfig, with fields: compaction_service (BaseCompactionService), tool_run_compactor_registry (ToolRunCompactorRegistry), patch_compactor (PatchCompactor), enable_deterministic_compaction (bool, default True), enable_observational_memory (bool, default False)
After each tool run event in the runner (in compaction.py or appropriate hook), if deterministic compaction is enabled, the appropriate compactor runs and result is stored via compaction service
After each patch/diff event, the patch compactor runs similarly
Compaction runs inline (not background) since it's deterministic and fast
Existing EventsCompactionConfig and LlmEventSummarizer continue to work unchanged (backward compatible)
Integration test showing compaction artifacts are created for a multi-turn agent session with tool calls
Typecheck/lint passes

userStories.title: Implement Observation writer
userStories.description: As a coding agent framework, I want to periodically generate concise narrative observations over spans of events for narrative continuity.
acceptanceCriteria: Create src/google/adk/compaction/writers/__init__.py
Create src/google/adk/compaction/writers/observation_writer.py with ObservationWriter class
Takes inputs: recent raw turns, recent ToolRunCompactions/PatchCompactions, current TaskState, optionally last Observation
Triggers when token budget for raw events exceeds configurable threshold OR when episode closes
Uses an LLM (via ADK's BaseLlm) to generate one Observation JSON covering the seq range
Prompt template enforces: every decision/constraint must include evidence_refs pointing to event_ids/tool_run_ids
kind field on decisions is 'explicit' only when directly supported by evidence; otherwise 'inferred'
Observations are append-only (stored via compaction service)
Unit test with mocked LLM verifying observation structure and evidence ref requirements
Typecheck/lint passes

userStories.title: Implement Reflection writer
userStories.description: As a coding agent framework, I want to periodically condense multiple observations into a single reflection for long-session stability.
acceptanceCriteria: Create src/google/adk/compaction/writers/reflection_writer.py with ReflectionWriter class
Takes a window of Observations (e.g. 10-20)
Triggers when observation count exceeds configurable threshold (default 10)
Uses LLM to generate one Reflection JSON citing observation_ids
Every stable_fact, recurring_failure, and strategy_update must cite evidence_refs
New facts not supported by observations are omitted or labeled as hypotheses
Unit test with mocked LLM verifying reflection structure
Typecheck/lint passes

userStories.title: Implement TaskState updater
userStories.description: As a coding agent framework, I want a small stable working memory anchor that is always included in the prompt.
acceptanceCriteria: Create src/google/adk/compaction/writers/task_state_updater.py with TaskStateUpdater class
Updates TaskState after each Observation or key tool run
Constraints and decisions enter TaskState only if supported by evidence refs or explicit user instruction
Inferred statements go to hypotheses list, not constraints
TaskState is versioned (bumps state_version on each update)
TaskState is capped to small token budget (configurable, default ~200 tokens)
Can be updated deterministically (from compaction artifacts) or via LLM (from observations)
Unit tests verifying provenance requirements and version bumping
Typecheck/lint passes

userStories.title: Implement rehydration planner and executor
userStories.description: As a coding agent framework, I want to pull raw evidence on demand when summaries aren't enough for debugging loops.
acceptanceCriteria: Create src/google/adk/compaction/rehydration.py with RehydrationPlanner and RehydrationExecutor classes
RehydrationPlanner reads: TaskState, recent observations, recent compactions, latest user message
Planner outputs retrieval queries with filters: error signature, test name, file path, time range
RehydrationExecutor fetches from compaction service: matching compactions by error signature, file path, and time range
Results packaged as EvidencePack model (list of raw excerpts + compacted artifacts)
EvidencePack has configurable token budget (default 2000 tokens)
Triggers on: missing evidence, repeated error signatures (thrash detection), user referencing older specifics
Unit tests for planner query generation and executor retrieval
Typecheck/lint passes

userStories.title: Implement hybrid prompt assembly
userStories.description: As a coding agent framework, I want the prompt assembled from hybrid layers so most turns are cache-friendly.
acceptanceCriteria: Create src/google/adk/compaction/assembly.py with HybridPromptAssembler class

Builds prompt from layers: (1) System instructions, (2) TaskState, (3) Latest Reflection if any, (4) Last 1-3 Observations, (5) Last K raw turns bounded, (6) Latest ToolRunCompactions/PatchCompactions bounded
When rehydration is triggered, Evidence Pack is inserted after Observations
Total token budget for assembled prompt is configurable
Falls back to existing _get_contents behavior when hybrid compaction is not configured
Integration test comparing prompt token counts between existing compaction and hybrid compaction over a 20+ turn session
Typecheck/lint passes

userStories.title: Add SQLite-based compaction service
userStories.description: As a developer deploying ADK with persistent sessions, I want compaction artifacts stored in SQLite.
acceptanceCriteria: Create src/google/adk/compaction/storage/sqlite_compaction_service.py with SqliteCompactionService implementing BaseCompactionService
Schema with tables for: tool_run_compactions, patch_compactions, observations, reflections, task_states
Uses aiosqlite (consistent with existing SqliteSessionService)
Supports query_by_error_signature and query_by_file_path via indexed columns
Migration support for schema changes (version field in a metadata table)
Integration tests with actual SQLite database covering CRUD and query operations
Typecheck/lint passes

userStories.title: End-to-end integration test
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a full integration test demonstrating the hybrid compaction system working end-to-end.
acceptanceCriteria: Test simulates a 20+ turn session with: user messages, tool calls (pytest with failures), patches/diffs, follow-up debugging
Verifies deterministic compactions are created for each tool run and patch
Verifies observations are generated at configured intervals
Verifies TaskState is maintained and updated with provenance
Verifies that after compaction, error signatures and file:line refs are still retrievable
Verifies rehydration can recover raw evidence for a specific error signature
Compares token usage vs existing LLM-only compaction (should show improvement)
Uses InMemoryCompactionService (no external dependencies)
